prompt: After the cold rain, the swans have (little) open water than before.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым существительным water в сравнительной степени используется форма less (от little), а не fewer.

prompt: With the new bike offer, ___ cyclists park here than in winter.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе (cyclists) усилитель перед more — many (many more), а не much more.

prompt: "We don't have (many) sweet biscuits as we need for our guests."
explanation_ru: Конструкция (not) as/so many + исчисляемое существительное + as выражает нехватку количества по сравнению с нужным.

prompt: Our building got less fake phone messages in May than in August.
answer: Our building got fewer fake phone messages in May than in August.
accepted_answers: Our building got fewer fake phone messages in May than in August.
explanation_ru: Messages — исчисляемое существительное во множественном числе, поэтому вместо less нужно употребить fewer.

prompt: Because winter snow was thin on the high peaks, valley farms have (little / water) than usual for growing melons.
explanation_ru: Water — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому в сравнении с than используется форма less water.

prompt: Our young garden tree grew (fast) than I expected, and its branches shade the whole veranda.
explanation_ru: Наречие fast совпадает по форме с прилагательным и образует сравнительную степень при помощи суффикса -er (faster), а не more fast.

prompt: Warm August evenings bring big crowds to our open-air cinema in Lucca. Tonight, (many) families came than the staff expected. Everyone wanted a good seat near the big screen. The helpers worked (hard) than usual, but they still ran out of chairs.
explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень от many — more (more families); наречие hard образует сравнительную степень с помощью -er (worked harder), а не more hard.

prompt: Jukka's local bakery charges the same price, but its sweet rolls weigh less than in autumn.
options: Jukka gets fewer cake for the same money.
The bakery sells less sweet rolls than before.
Jukka gets less food for his money than before.
The bakery makes more small rolls as in autumn.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым food используется less; в остальных вариантах нарушено правило fewer/less или построение сравнительной степени.

prompt: Without long speeches, our classmates laughed and talked (easily) than before.
explanation_ru: Наречия на -ly (easily) образуют сравнительную степень при помощи more (more easily).

prompt: Have the morning balance classes helped your neighbours climb the stairs (steadily) than last winter?
explanation_ru: После глагола climb нужно наречие steadily в сравнительной степени — more steadily.

prompt: Torben spent two months fixing an old oak boat at the Ribe yard. After his team fitted a wider sail, the boat moved (smoothly) across the bay than before. It did not turn (slowly) in strong winds as it used to. In fact, the crew steered it (well) than any modern boat in the harbour.
explanation_ru: Наречие smoothly требует more (more smoothly); в отрицательном сравнении с as используется as/so slowly; сравнительная степень наречия well — исключение better.

prompt: Stjepan told us that tourists visit his quiet island bay ___ in October than they did a decade ago.
explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень наречия often — more often, усиленная словом far (far more often); формы oftenly в английском не существует.

prompt: Are there (few) part-time museum jobs in Canterbury this autumn than in summer?
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе (jobs) используется сравнительная степень fewer.

prompt: There are less dry hangers in the hall because everyone brought a wet coat.
answer: There are fewer dry hangers in the hall because everyone brought a wet coat.
accepted_answers: There are fewer dry hangers in the hall because everyone brought a wet coat.
explanation_ru: Hangers — исчисляемое существительное во множественном числе, поэтому вместо less требуется fewer.

prompt: We apologise that the box office printed (few) song sheets than we had visitors, so please share with your neighbour.
explanation_ru: Song sheets можно посчитать, поэтому в сравнении с than используется форма fewer.

prompt: Our table doesn't have (much) glue as the other group for these paper lamps.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым существительным glue в отрицательном сравнении используется конструкция not as/so much ... as.

prompt: Dear Council Members, I am writing on behalf of our local stargazing club in Albuquerque. Since those bright road signs went up, we cannot see faint stars (clearly) as we used to. Our club members also spend (much) time driving outside the town to find a dark hill. Could the city dim the lights after midnight so people can study the night sky (easily)?
explanation_ru: В отрицательном сравнении с as используется as/so clearly; для большего количества времени — more (от much); наречие easily в сравнительной степени имеет форму more easily.

prompt: Do your online craft parcels also arrive (late) this winter than they did in autumn, Cheryl?
explanation_ru: Наречие late образует сравнительную степень при помощи суффикса -er (later), без слова more.

prompt: Fast spring water meant that beginners paddled more careful than usual on the river.
answer: Fast spring water meant that beginners paddled more carefully than usual on the river.
accepted_answers: Fast spring water meant that beginners paddled more carefully than usual on the river.
explanation_ru: После глагола paddled требуется наречие (more carefully), а не прилагательное (more careful).

prompt: Cristina's report showed that short forty-second gardening videos are shared much (widely) online than the office's long printed newsletters ever were.
explanation_ru: Наречие на -ly (widely) в сравнительной степени требует вспомогательного слова more (more widely).

prompt: Please arrive early because ___ shaded spaces are free at four than at noon.
explanation_ru: Spaces — исчисляемое существительное, и в предложении есть сравнение с than, поэтому верный вариант — fewer.

prompt: Thanks to the bright new signs at Atlanta Airport, I changed terminals (quickly) than on my previous visit.
explanation_ru: Наречие quickly образует сравнительную степень с помощью more (more quickly).

prompt: Dozens of students came to print essays on a rainy afternoon, so Nolan's copy shop almost ran out of paper.
options: The copy shop has never used as many paper in one afternoon.
The copy shop has fewer paper left than it had in the morning.
Students printed more fast than the old machine could handle.
The copy shop has far less white paper left than it had at noon.
explanation_ru: Paper в значении «бумага» неисчисляемо, поэтому верно far less white paper; варианты с many paper, fewer paper и more fast грамматически ошибочны.

prompt: The cliff pools do not hold as much fresh water this autumn as they held in spring. → The cliff pools hold …
answer: The cliff pools hold less fresh water this autumn than they held in spring.
accepted_answers: The cliff pools hold less fresh water this autumn than they held in spring.
The cliff pools hold less fresh water this autumn than in spring.
explanation_ru: Конструкцию not as much + неисчисляемое существительное + as можно заменить на сравнительную степень less ... than.

prompt: Sofie shared her office update with the Kortrijk team on Monday. With online timetables, staff organise weekly shifts (carefully) than they did in spring. Nobody wastes paper on printed charts anymore. Everyone also answers client emails (fast) and finishes Friday work (early) than before.
explanation_ru: Наречие carefully требует more (more carefully), короткое наречие fast — суффикса -er (faster), а early меняет -y на -ier (earlier).

prompt: Annelies reported that neighbours sleep much (calmly) and worry far less about garden sheds since the street added soft porch lights.
explanation_ru: После глагола sleep стоит наречие calmly, которое в сравнительной степени принимает форму more calmly.

prompt: After five wet mornings, we have fewer dry gloves in the hallway than children in the house.
answer: After five wet mornings, we have fewer dry gloves in the hallway than children in the house.
accepted_answers: After five wet mornings, we have fewer dry gloves in the hallway than children in the house.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: с исчисляемым существительным gloves правильно использовано fewer и союз than.

prompt: Garth fitted soft wall panels inside our small recording studio in Nanaimo. Street traffic does not leak into the microphones anymore. Voice actors speak (softly) than before because there is no room echo. They finish each episode (early) and act (well) than they did in the noisy old room.
explanation_ru: Softly образует сравнительную степень через more (more softly), early — через -ier (earlier), а well имеет неправильную форму better.

prompt: Tanya wrote that the live band drew so many people that the tiny porch had ___ space than a crowded bus.
explanation_ru: Space в значении «место, пространство» неисчисляемо, поэтому перед ним в сравнении с than нужно слово less.

prompt: Our extra guests arrived (soon) than we planned, so we need more spoons!
explanation_ru: Односложное наречие soon образует сравнительную степень с помощью суффикса -er (sooner).

prompt: Carla's health notice in Olympia warns night-shift staff about using bright tablets in bed. Workers who read on screens before sleep fall asleep (slowly) than those who read printed books. They also wake up more often during the night and recover (badly) from long shifts than people who put phones away. Turning devices off an hour before bed helps adults rest (deeply) and wake up calmer.
explanation_ru: Наречия slowly и deeply образуют сравнительную степень с more (more slowly, more deeply), а наречие badly имеет неправильную форму worse.

prompt: Because the mountain wind turned bitterly cold after dusk, our little cabin stove burned through the dry wood much (quickly) than we had expected.
explanation_ru: Глагол burned описывается наречием quickly, сравнительная степень которого — more quickly.

prompt: Szymon's autumn report confirmed that part-time library posts did not attract ___ applicants in spring as they do this season.
explanation_ru: Applicants — исчисляемое существительное во множественном числе, поэтому в конструкции с as требуется as many, а не as much.

prompt: In Estela's painting class, adult beginners choose bright orange skies (often) than pale grey ones.
explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень наречия often — more often.

prompt: Hi Aunt Astrid, our choir in Molde has started doing short warm-ups on Mondays. Nobody sings (loudly) as they used to in autumn. We practise (hard) than before, and the whole group sounds much nicer. You must come to our winter concert!
explanation_ru: С отрицательным подлежащим nobody и союзом as используется as/so loudly; глагол practise с наречием hard образует сравнение practise harder.

prompt: Jodie noted that the small solar sensors measure light showers far (reliably) than the rusty metal buckets the station used before.
explanation_ru: Наречие reliably образует сравнительную степень при помощи more (more reliably), а слово far усиливает сравнение.

prompt: The honey jar does not contain as much honey as it contained last year, even though the glass looks identical. → The honey jar contains …
answer: The honey jar contains less honey than it contained last year, even though the glass looks identical.
accepted_answers: The honey jar contains less honey than it contained last year, even though the glass looks identical.
The honey jar contains less honey than last year, even though the glass looks identical.
explanation_ru: Отрицательное сравнение does not contain as much honey as передаётся через утвердительное contains less honey than.

prompt: Hi Uncle Paul, I wanted to tell you how my swimming is going in Leicester. Since January, I have trained (regularly) than I did during the autumn term. My coach fixed my kicking technique, so I do not breathe (heavily) as I used to at the end of a length. Last Tuesday I swam (far) than anyone else in my lane without stopping for a rest.
explanation_ru: Regularly образует форму more regularly; после do not и перед as нужно as/so heavily; наречие far имеет неправильную форму further/farther.

prompt: Because of the huge flashing ads, this train app leaves fewer space on screen for platform numbers than the old version.
answer: Because of the huge flashing ads, this train app leaves less space on screen for platform numbers than the old version.
accepted_answers: Because of the huge flashing ads, this train app leaves less space on screen for platform numbers than the old version.
explanation_ru: Space (свободное место на экране) — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому вместо fewer нужно less.

prompt: Cycling along the canal in Alkmaar used to feel stressful on wet mornings. With the wider bike crossings, I ride (safely) past the busy buses than before. My morning commute also does not take (long) as it did in winter. You should bring your bike when you visit.
explanation_ru: Наречие safely образует сравнительную степень через more (more safely), а отрицательная конструкция с as требует as/so long.

prompt: Tapio writes short notes after every lecture instead of studying all night, so he handles exams much better than in his first term.
options: Tapio studies more hard now, so he feels more calm before exams.
Tapio prepares more organisedly and sleeps the most well in his flat.
Tapio revises more effectively than before and worries far less during exam weeks.
Tapio spends fewer time reading notes than he spent in his first term.
explanation_ru: Верный вариант использует правильное наречие more effectively и глагольное сравнение worries far less; в других вариантах есть ошибки more hard, the most well и fewer time.

prompt: Nika noticed during her morning swims in Koper that the sea mist lingers ___ over the bay in November than in September.
explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень наречия late — later, а для усиления используется far (far later); слово very со сравнительной степенью не сочетается.
